name: EPIC 220194207
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 11.2 solar radii and 1.31 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220194207 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.199395 (16th-84th percentiles 10.607687-11.874553), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,819 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.31 solar masses and 11.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,808 K at its surface.
